## Problem Statement

What problem does this feature solve?
Is your request related to a limitation, missing capability, or a specific use case?

## Proposed Solution

Describe your ideal API, behavior, or developer experience.

**Example:**

```tsx
// Proposed API
<NewComponent
  prop1={value}
  prop2={value}
>
  {children}
</NewComponent>
```

## Alternatives Considered

Have you tried any workarounds?
What other approaches or libraries did you explore?

## Use Case

Describe a real-world scenario where this feature would be valuable.
Explain why it fits Layr’s design philosophy.

## Flutter Equivalent (if applicable)

If this feature exists in Flutter, link to the Flutter documentation
or describe the equivalent widget and behavior.

## Additional Context

Add mockups, code sketches, screenshots, or links to similar implementations
in other libraries.
